objective: Take the Ensorcelled Parchment to Loremaster Dibbs in Southshore.
start: Found in Worn Wooden Chest in Alterac Mountains

description: This parchment is enchanted with a spell, rendering it indecipherable.  But one word at the top of the paper can be read:
progress: Oh. You have something you'd like me to look at? Some scrap of lore gathered from up in the mountains, I hope...
completion: I wish I had the talents to decrypt all the strange bits of writing that trickle down from Alterac. But I'm afraid I lack the knowledge.
